title: Induction of surjective maps on augmented polynomial truncations
statement: Let B and C be commutative rings, C a B-algebra, ε : C → B a B-algebra augmentation, I = ker ε, n a natural number, P = B[X₁,…,Xₙ], and J its variables ideal. Let f : P → C be a B-algebra map with f(J) ⊆ I. Assume the induced P/J² → C/I² is surjective. Then each induced P/Jᵏ → C/Iᵏ is surjective, for every natural k. No formal smoothness is assumed.

proof.text: Extract elementwise representatives modulo I² from h₂. Prove by induction on k that every c in I^k has a polynomial p with c-f(p) in I^(k+1). At k=0 choose the constant ε(c). For the successor, use ideal-product induction. For a in I^k and b in I, choose p from the induction and q from h₂. Then f(p) belongs to I^k, and a*b-f(p*q)=(a-f(p))*b+f(p)*(b-f(q)) belongs to I^(k+2). Add polynomial representatives for sums. No membership condition on p in the variables ideal is needed.

Induct on k to construct representatives of every c in C modulo I^k. For k=0 choose zero, since I^0 is the whole ring. At the successor, apply the graded approximation just proved to the error c-f(p) and add its representative q to p. Finally apply quotient surjectivity of the quotient constructor and the quotient equality criterion to obtain surjectivity of the induced polynomial quotient map.

lean.statement:
theorem bijective_augmented_polynomial_truncations_surjective
    (B C : Type u) [CommRing B] [CommRing C] [Algebra B C]
    (ε : C →ₐ[B] B) (n : ℕ)
    (f : MvPolynomial (Fin n) B →ₐ[B] C)
    (hf : MvPolynomial.idealOfVars (Fin n) B ≤
      (RingHom.ker ε.toRingHom).comap f.toRingHom)
    (h₂ : Function.Surjective
      (Ideal.quotientMapₐ ((RingHom.ker ε.toRingHom) ^ 2) f
        ((pow_le_pow_left' hf 2).trans (Ideal.le_comap_pow f.toRingHom 2)))) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, Function.Surjective
      (Ideal.quotientMapₐ ((RingHom.ker ε.toRingHom) ^ k) f
        ((pow_le_pow_left' hf k).trans (Ideal.le_comap_pow f.toRingHom k)))
